Implementation status: - The ESLint rule `require-branch-annotation` is implemented and thoroughly tested. - There are explicit Jest suites tied to this story for functionality, configuration helper behavior, and performance, and all of them pass. - Tests cover: - Detection of missing annotations on all significant branch types (if/switch/loops/try-catch/finally). - Correct association of comments with branches and parsing of @story and @req tags. - Nested branch handling (both valid and invalid nested cases). - Configurable branch types (`branchTypes`) and invalid configuration reporting. - Performance on large, deeply nested-branch files. - The rule is integrated into the plugin’s exported rules and configuration presets. - User-facing documentation includes this rule with usage and configuration examples consistent with the story.
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in the story are demonstrably satisfied, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
